name: Venus
description: The goddess of love (also called Cytherea), here the ardent, overpowering wooer of Adonis. Eloquent, sensuous, and finally grief-stricken. A narrated figure, not a stage speaker.

name: Adonis
description: A beautiful young hunter who scorns love and longs only for the chase. He resists Venus, hunts the boar, and is gored to death; his blood becomes a flower.
